# UI component index

Every `ds-` class declared in `src/ui/*.css`, with where it is declared and how many
times `src/**` references it. **Look here before adding a class** — the reason this file
exists is that 240 classes across 8,700 lines of CSS is not greppable in practice, and a
new class is what gets written when the grep is inconclusive.

`used 0` means the CSS is dead, or the class is composed at runtime from string pieces
this scan cannot see. Both are worth a look.

Composition rules — page/panel/row/dialog/list skeletons — are `docs/ui-standard.md` §6.
The look and the depth model are `DESIGN.md`. This file is only the inventory.
